Users can call `pack` and `cash` after `thaw`. Ensures debt is covered and collateral is distributed fairly.\n * @custom:events Emits events for each phase to ensure transparency.\n */\ncontract GlobalSettlement is SuAuthenticated, Math {\n    // --- Data ---\n    /// @notice Reference to the SafeEngine contract for debt and collateral management.\n    /// @dev Immutable reference to SafeEngine, which handles debt and collateral balances, similar to MakerDAO's Vat.\n    ISafeEngine public  safeEngine;\n    /// @notice Reference to the CoinJoin contract for StablePro operations.\n    /// @dev Immutable reference to CoinJoin, used for StablePro (equivalent to Dai) operations.\n    ICoinJoin public  coinJoin;\n    /// @notice Reference to the AccountingEngine for debt settlement.\n    /// @dev Immutable reference to AccountingEngine, which manages debt settlement, similar to MakerDAO's Vow.\n    IAccountingEngine public  accountingEngine;\n    /// @notice Reference to the AccountingEngine for debt settlement.\n    /// @dev Immutable reference to AccountingEngine, which manages debt settlement, similar to MakerDAO's Vow.\n    ILiquidationEngine public  liquidationEngine;\n    /// @notice Reference to the TaxCollector for debt settlement.\n    /// @dev Immutable reference to TaxCollector, which manages debt settlement, similar to MakerDAO's Vow.\n    ITaxCollector public  taxCollector;\n    /// @notice caged.\n    /// @dev Tracks whether the system is live (1) or caged (0), same as End.sol's `live`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `live`.\n    uint256 public live;\n    /// @notice Timestamp when cage was initiated.\n    /// @dev Records when `cage` was called to enforce wait period, equivalent to End.sol's `when`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `when`.\n    uint256 public when;\n    /// @notice Delay before thaw can be called (6 hours).\n    /// @dev Wait period before `thaw` can be called, set to 6 hours, configurable via `modifyParameters`.\n    /// each collateral type (WAD).\n    /// @dev Stores total debt value in WAD (10^18) after `cageCollateral`, equivalent to End.sol's `Art`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `Art[ilk]` for total debt value for each collateral type.\n    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) public totalDebt;\n    /// @notice Exchange rate for StablePro to collateral (RAD/WAD).\n    /// @dev Stores exchange rate for StablePro to collateral in RAY (10^27), set in `flow`, equivalent to End.sol's `fix`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `fix[ilk]`.\n    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) public fix;\n    /// @notice StablePro packed by users for redemption (RAD).\n    /// @dev Tracks StablePro (in RAD) packed by users for redemption, equivalent to End.sol's `bag`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to contracts, replacing End.sol's direct `vat.flux` calls.\n    /// @custom:maker End.sol does not use CollateralJoin; it uses `vat.flux` directly for collateral transfers.\n    mapping(bytes32 => address) public collateralJoin;\n\n    // --- Constants ---\n    /// @notice Decimal precision for rates and prices (10^27).\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's RAY, used for debt and exchange rate calculations.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `RAY = 10**27`.\n    uint256 constant RAY = 10**27;\n    /// @notice Decimal precision for rates and prices (10^45).\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's RAD, used for debt and exchange rate calculations.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `RAD = 10**45`.\n    uint256 constant RAD = 10**45;\n\n    // --- Events ---\n    /// @notice Emitted when the system is shut down.\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's `Cage()`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `Cage()` event.\n    event Cage(uint256 timestamp);\n    /// @notice this event adds transparency.\n    event CageCollateral(bytes32 indexed collateralType, uint256 price);\n    /// @notice Emitted when a CDP is processed.\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's `Skim(bytes32 `Thaw()`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `Thaw()` event, but includes `totalDebt` for clarity.\n    event Thaw(uint256 totalDebt);\n    /// @notice Emitted when a user packs StablePro.\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's `Pack(address usr, uint wad)`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `Pack` event.\n    event Pack(address indexed user, uint256 amount);\n    /// @notice Emitted when a user redeems collateral.\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's `Cash(bytes32 ilk, address usr, uint wad)`.\n    /// @custom:maker Similar to End.sol's `Cash`, but includes `stableProAmount` and `collateralAmount` for clarity.\n    event Cash(bytes32 indexed collateralType, address indexed user, uint256 stableProAmount, uint256 collateralAmount);\n    /// @notice Emitted when parameters are modified (address).\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's implicit event in `file(bytes32 ilk, bytes32 what, address data)`.\n    /// @custom:maker End.sol does not explicitly emit an event for `file(address)`, but this adds transparency.\n    event ModifyParameters(bytes32 indexed collateralType, bytes32 what, address data);\n    /// @notice Emitted when parameters are modified (uint256).\n    /// @dev Matches End.sol's implicit event in `file(bytes32 what, uint data)`.\n    /// @custom:maker End.sol does not explicitly emit an event for `file(uint)`, but this adds transparency.\n    event ModifyParameters(bytes32 what, uint256 data);\n\n     event ModifyParameters(bytes32 what, address data);\n    // --- Modifiers ---\n    /// @dev Ensures function can only be called when system is live (live == 1).\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `when(live)` modifier.\n    modifier onlyWhenLive() {\n        require(live == 1, \"GlobalSettlement/not-live\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Ensures function can only be called when system is caged (live == 0).\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `when(!live)` implicit check.\n    modifier onlyWhenCaged() {\n        require(live == 0, \"GlobalSettlement/not-caged\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Ensures function can only be called after the wait period post-cage.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `when >= wait` check in `thaw`.\n    modifier onlyAfterWait() {\n        require(block.timestamp >= when + wait, \"GlobalSettlement/wait-not-finished\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /// @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor\n    constructor() {\n        _disableInitializers();\n    }\n\n    // --- Init ---\n    /**\n     * @notice Initializes the GlobalSettlement contract with required addresses.\n     * @dev Sets  references and configures initial state. Approves CoinJoin for SafeEngine modifications.\n     * @param accessControl_ Address of the access control singleton.\n\n     */\n    /// @dev Constructor sets up  contract references, initializes live to 1, sets wait to 6 hours, and approves CoinJoin.\n    /// @custom:maker End.sol constructor sets `vat`, `cat`, `vow`, `pot`, `spot`, and approves `vat` for `cat`, `vow`, `pot`. This contract uses `safeEngine`, `coinJoin`, `accountingEngine`, `oracle`, and `accessControl`, with approval for `coinJoin` only.\n    function initialize(\n        address accessControl_\n    ) public initializer {\n\n        __suAuthenticatedInit(accessControl_);\n\n        /// @dev Initialize system as live.\n        live = 1;\n        /// @dev Set default wait period to 6 hours.\n        wait = 6 hours;\n\n    }\n\n\n\n    // --- Administration ---\n    /**\n     * @notice Sets the CollateralJoin contract for a collateral type.\n     * @dev Only callable by DAO.\n     * @param collateralType Unique identifier for the collateral type.\n     * @param join Address of the CollateralJoin contract.\n     */\n    function setCollateralJoin(bytes32 collateralType, address join) external onlyDAO onlyWhenLive {\n        /// @dev Ensure the provided CollateralJoin address is not zero.\n        require(join != address(0), \"GlobalSettlement/invalid-join\");\n        /// @dev Ensure the CollateralJoin address is valid.\n        /// @dev Store the CollateralJoin address for the given collateral type.\n        collateralJoin[collateralType] = join;\n        /// @dev Store the CollateralJoin address for the collateral type.\n        /// @dev Emit event to signal parameter modification.\n        /// @custom:maker End.sol does not emit an event for `file`, but this adds transparency.\n        emit ModifyParameters(collateralType, \"join\", join);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Modifies the wait period.\n     * @dev Only callable by DAO.\n     * @param what Parameter to modify (\"wait\").\n     * @param newWait New wait period in seconds.\n     */\n    /// @dev Equivalent to End.sol's `file(bytes32 what, uint data)` for setting `wait`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `file` for setting `wait`, but with explicit event emission.\n    function modifyParameters(bytes32 what, uint256 newWait) external onlyDAO {\n        /// @dev Check if the parameter is \"wait\" and update it.\n        if (what == \"wait\") wait = newWait;\n        else revert(\"GlobalSettlement/invalid-param\");\n        /// @dev Emit event to signal parameter modification.\n        /// @custom:maker End.sol does not emit an event for `file`, but this adds transparency.\n        emit ModifyParameters(what, newWait);\n    }\n\n        /// @dev Equivalent to End.sol's `file(bytes32 what, address data)` for setting `wait`.\n    /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `file` for setting `wait`, but with explicit event emission.\n    function modifyParameters(bytes32 what, address data) external onlyDAO {\n        // Original Flip.sol: if (what == \"vat\") vat = data; else revert(\"Flip/file-unrecognized-param\"); (lines 77-79)\n        // Updates AccountingEngine address for debt settlement\n        if (what == \"safeEngine\") {\n            safeEngine = ISafeEngine(data);\n        }\n        else if (what == \"coinJoin\") {\n            coinJoin = ICoinJoin(data);\n            // @dev Approve CoinJoin to modify SafeEngine balances, similar to Vat approvals in End.sol.\n            safeEngine.approveSAFEModification(data);\n        }\n        else if (what == \"accountingEngine\") {\n            accountingEngine = IAccountingEngine(data);\n        }\n        else if (what == \"taxCollector\") {\n            taxCollector =      oracle = ISuOracleAggregator(data);\n        } else {\n            revert(\"GlobalSettlement/modify-unrecognized-param\");\n        }\n\n        // Emit event to log address update\n        emit ModifyParameters(what, data);\n    }\n\n    // --- Phase 1: System Shutdown ---\n    /**\n     * @notice Initiates global settlement, stopping system operations.\n     * @dev Disables SafeEngine, AccountingEngine, and sets system state to caged.\n     *      Only callable by DAO.\n     */\n    /// @dev Equivalent to End.sol's `cage()`.\n    /// @custom:maker Similar to End.sol's `cage()`, but disables `safeEngine` and `accountingEngine` instead of `vat`, `cat`, `vow`, `spot`, `pot`. Also includes disabling auctions, which is commented out here.\n    function cage() external onlyDAO onlyWhenLive {\n        /// @dev Set system to caged (not live).\n        live = 0;\n        /// @dev Record timestamp of cage initiation.\n        when = block.timestamp;\n        /// @dev Disable SafeEngine to stop normal operations.\n        /// @custom:maker End.sol calls `vat.cage()`, while this uses `safeEngine.disableContract()`.\n        safeEngine.disableContract();\n        /// @dev Disable AccountingEngine to stop debt settlement.\n        /// @custom:maker End.sol calls `vow.cage()`, while this uses `accountingEngine.disableContract()`.\n        accountingEngine.disableContract();\n\n        /// @dev Disable LiquidationEngine to stop liqudation\n        /// @custom:maker End.sol calls `vow.cage()`, while this uses `accountingEngine.disableContract()`.\n        liquidationEngine.disableContract();\n\n        /// @dev Disable TaxCollector to accumulate rate\n        /// @custom:maker End.sol calls `jug.cage()`, while this uses `accountingEngine.disableContract()`.\n        taxCollector.disableContract();\n\n        /// @dev Emit event to signal system shutdown.\n        /// @custom:maker Identical to End.sol's `Cage()` event.\n        emit Cage(when);\n    }\n\n    // --- Phase 2: Collateral Price Fixing ---\n    /**\n     * @notice Fixes the price of a collateral type using the oracle.\n     * @dev Updates accumulatedRate and sets tag. devdoc.custom:events: Emits events for each phase to ensure transparency.
devdoc.custom:security: Only authorized accounts (DAO for `cage`, Admin for `cageCollateral`, `skim`, `thaw`) can call state-changing                 functions. Users can call `pack` and `cash` after `thaw`. Ensures debt is covered and collateral is distributed fairly.
devdoc.custom:usage: - **Initialization**: Deploy with required contract addresses.   ```solidity   GlobalSettlement settlement = new GlobalSettlement(accessControl, safeEngine, coinJoin, accountingEngine, oracle);   ``` - **System Shutdown**: Initiate global settlement.   ```solidity   settlement.cage();   ``` - **Collateral Price Fixing**: Set prices for each collateral type.   ```solidity   settlement.cageCollateral("ETH-A");   ``` - **CDP Processing**: Process individual or multiple CDPs.   ```solidity   settlement.skimCDP("ETH-A", cdp);   settlement.batchSkimCDPs("ETH-A", cdps);   ``` - **Exchange Rate Calculation**: Finalize exchange rates after wait period.   ```solidity   settlement.thaw();   ``` - **Redemption**: Users pack StablePro and redeem collateral.   ```solidity   settlement.pack(amount);   settlement.cash("ETH-A", amount);   ```
devdoc.details: Implements a multi-phase process: system shutdown (`cage`), collateral price fixing (`cageCollateral`), CDP processing (`skim`),      exchange rate calculation (`thaw`), and StablePro redemption (`pack`, `cash`). Integrates with SafeEngine for debt and collateral      management, CoinJoin for StablePro, CollateralJoin for collateral, and AccountingEngine for debt settlement. Inspired by MakerDAO's      End.sol, adapted for StableUnit with SuAuthenticated access control and ISuOracleAggregator for prices.

collateralJoin.details: Maps collateral types to their CollateralJoin contracts, replacing End.sol's direct `vat.flux` calls.

debt.details: Tracks total system debt in RAD (10^45), updated during `skimCDP` and `thaw`, similar to End.sol's `debt`.

fix.details: Stores exchange rate for StablePro to collateral in RAY (10^27), set in `flow`, equivalent to End.sol's `fix`.

gap.details: Tracks collateral available for redemption in WAD (10^18), equivalent to End.sol's `gap`.

liquidationEngine.details: Immutable reference to AccountingEngine, which manages debt settlement, similar to MakerDAO's Vow.

live.details: Tracks whether the system is live (1) or caged (0), same as End.sol's `live`.

oracle.custom:maker: In End.sol, collateral prices are fetched via Pip (DSValue) contracts per ilk, not a single oracle aggregator.
oracle.details: Immutable reference to SuOracleAggregator, replacing MakerDAO's individual Pip oracles per collateral type.

safeEngine.details: Immutable reference to SafeEngine, which handles debt and collateral balances, similar to MakerDAO's Vat.

tag.custom:maker: Identical to End.sol's `tag[ilk]` for collateral prices.
tag.details: Stores fixed collateral prices in WAD (10^18) after `cageCollateral`, equivalent to End.sol's `tag`.

taxCollector.details: Immutable reference to TaxCollector, which manages debt settlement, similar to MakerDAO's Vow.

totalDebt.custom:maker: Identical to End.sol's `Art[ilk]` for total debt value for each collateral type.
totalDebt.details: Stores total debt value in WAD (10^18) after `cageCollateral`, equivalent to End.sol's `Art`.

wait.custom:maker: End.sol has a similar `wait` variable, but its default value is not explicitly set to 6 hours.
wait.details: Wait period before `thaw` can be called, set to 6 hours, configurable via `modifyParameters`.

when.details: Records when `cage` was called to enforce wait period, equivalent to End.sol's `when`.
